column5: question
What kind of decision is this?
column6: Pick the closest. Refunds, cancellations and other contract rights, or access to education: pick Eligibility. Credit-like scoring is not in this check.

column5: Does it use personal information?
column6: A name, contact details, an application, or account history. Health or biometric data counts too.

column5: Who makes the call?
column6: A score or shortlist a person relies on can still count, even when a person reviews it. A word processor used only to write up the decision does not.
column8: 0=Program decides|1=Program helps decide|2=A person decides|3=Not sure

column5: Could it significantly affect someone?
column6: A job, a home, a service, a contract, a price, or an account. Good or bad outcomes count, and so does refusing or not deciding. A child or a person experiencing vulnerability may be affected more.

column5: Can a person review or override the outcome?
column6: A person who can change the result before it stands.
column15: No person can review or override the outcome before it stands.
column16: Add a human review and override step for decisions that affect people.

column5: Can the affected person ask for a review?
column6: A way for that person to request a second look.
column15: The affected person cannot ask for a review.
column16: Publish a simple way for people to ask for a second look.

column5: Who supplies the program?
column6: The vendor or team. Leave blank if you are not sure.

column5: Has the supplier explained how it works?
column6: A plain account of inputs, the decision, and the output.
column15: The supplier has not explained how the program works.
column16: Ask the supplier for a plain account of inputs, logic and outputs.

column5: Is turnover over A$3 million?
column6: A screen only, not a legal finding. If the business has opted in to the Privacy Act, pick Yes.

column5: Are you a health service provider?
Do you trade in personal information?
column6: Collecting or disclosing it for a benefit.

column5: Are you a Commonwealth contractor?
Who do you sell to?
Can customer data train a model?
column6: Keep training off unless they opted in.
column15: Customer data may train a model without opt-in.
column16: Keep training off by default and record any opt-in.

column5: Does it read customer documents?
column6: Retrieved files can leak across customers.
column15: Retrieval uses a shared index across customers.
column16: Enforce tenant isolation in retrieval before the model sees content.

column5: Who can read the vector store?
column6: Embeddings can leak data even when the chat is locked down.
column15: The vector store is readable too broadly.
column16: Restrict vector store access to named users and services.

column5: Where does the model run?
column6: A hosted API and your own model fail differently.
column15: The model runs in more than one place, so failure modes differ.
column16: Pin model versions and record where each model runs.

column5: Do you test prompt injection?
column15: Prompt injection is not tested in CI.
column16: Add a prompt-injection test suite to CI and treat output as untrusted.

column5: Are secrets kept out of the system prompt?
column6: A leaked system prompt can expose keys and hidden instructions.
column15: Secrets may sit in the system prompt.
column16: Move secrets out of the system prompt into a secrets manager.

column5: Can the AI take actions?
column6: A tool call can change data, send email, or write records.
column15: The AI can act on its own.
column16: Put a human approval step or allow-list on high-impact tool calls.

column5: Does the agent have least privilege and its own identity?
column6: ASD agentic guidance: a separate identity, and no shared admin rights.
column15: The agent lacks least privilege or its own identity.
column16: Give the agent its own identity with least-privilege, per-tenant credentials.

column5: Does a person approve the agent before it acts?
column6: A human approval step before the agent changes data or sends a message.
column16: Add a human approval step before the agent changes data or sends a message.

column5: Is MFA on for every console?
column15: MFA is not on for every console.
column16: Turn on phishing-resistant MFA for every console.

column5: Where do API keys live?
column15: API keys are not in a secrets manager.
column16: Move API keys into a secrets manager and rotate them.

column5: Do you log prompts and tool calls?
column15: Prompts and tool calls are not fully logged.
column16: Log prompts and tool calls with retention limits.

column5: Do you have a policy, a register, and a plan?
column15: AI policy, register or plan is missing.
column16: Adopt an AI policy, keep an AI register and write an incident plan.
